integrity: Complete finite CW reconstruction and homotopy-preserving elementary cancellation sequence are included as independent reproducibility artifacts; verification is same-model only.
limitations: Finite calculation only for the five-point proper NC lattice and its cyclic Kreweras action; not a general parameter family; possible equivalent unindexed work.
title: The Kreweras-complement quotient of the five-point noncrossing partition complex is a five-torsion Moore space
